parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: ProgramId
parameters.description: The ID of the playlist. If you specify this parameter, only the information about the specified playlist is returned. If you leave this parameter empty, the information about all playlists that belong to your account is returned. Use the ProgramId value returned by the [AddPlaylistItems](~~2848078~~) operation.
